subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Finally, they rebuilt the front of the theater and added modern safety systems inside.”?
options: When it reopened, the first show was about the theater's own history.
Her teacher suggested a history podcast about ordinary people in the past.
A history museum added smell boxes to an exhibit about old city life.
For the school art show, each student had to draw a picture about "home."

本文沒有陳述「Her teacher suggested a history podcast about ordinary people in the past.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
